asr.spans: large-v3 / medium.en / small.en on disputed spans (asr/spans_*.log, spans2_*.log)

note: timestamps are ASR word-level estimates (s); EN is unmasked; en_display is the on-screen masked form

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: ...trust you more than they trust their mother and father,
lines.en_display: ...trust you more than they trust their mother and father,
lines.jp: …自分の親より こっちを信用してんだよ
lines.note: 動画は文の途中から始まる。主語 they は前後から孫たち。you は一般的な「祖父母（俺）」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: because they know their mother and father can't beat you.
lines.en_display: because they know their mother and father can't beat you.
lines.jp: 親じゃ勝てねえって わかってるからな
lines.note: 2つ目の their は they とも聞こえる（MED）が意味は同じ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I tell my grandkids, I tell my granddaughters all the time,
lines.en_display: I tell my grandkids, I tell my granddaughters all the time,
lines.jp: 孫たちに 孫娘たちに いつも言ってんだ
lines.note: 冒頭の "Oh/So" はフィラーとして字幕にしない

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: You scared of your daddy?
lines.en_display: You scared of your daddy?
lines.jp: 「パパが怖いのか？
lines.note: 直前に "you see" と聞こえるモデルあり（低確率）

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I will beat your daddy. Your daddy ain't nothing.
lines.en_display: I will beat your daddy. Your daddy ain't nothing.
lines.jp: 俺がパパをぶっ倒してやる パパなんて屁でもねえ」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I said, how much money you think your daddy got?
lines.en_display: I said, how much money you think your daddy got?
lines.jp: 「パパがいくら持ってると思う？」って聞くと
lines.note: 区間再確認で said

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "He got a lot of money, Grandpa."
lines.en_display: "He got a lot of money, Grandpa."
lines.jp: 「いっぱい持ってるよ おじいちゃん」
lines.note: 孫娘のセリフをSnoopが再現

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I pulled out like $10,000 and thought,
lines.en_display: I pulled out like $10,000 and thought,
lines.jp: で 1万ドルくらい出して見せたら
lines.note: "and thought"（large-v3 区間・medium.en）/ "oh wow"（large-v3 全体・small.en）で割れた → §D。訳は「見せたら」で両方に対応

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "Wow, you have way more money than him."
lines.en_display: "Wow, you have way more money than him."
lines.jp: 「すごい パパよりずっとお金持ってる」
lines.note: 末尾の "bro" は medium.en のみが聞いたため字幕にしない

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: Yeah, you come holla at Grandpa when you need something.
lines.en_display: Yeah, you come holla at Grandpa when you need something.
lines.jp: だろ？ 何か欲しい時は じいちゃんに言いに来な
lines.note: holla at = 声をかける・頼みに来る

lines.speaker: Host (woman, on camera at the end)
lines.en: I know that's right.
lines.en_display: I know that's right.
lines.jp: ほんとそれ
lines.note: 相手に強く同意する口語表現

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I laid the law down with my grandbabies
lines.en_display: I laid the law down with my grandbabies
lines.jp: 孫たちには ビシッと教えといたんだ
lines.note: lay down the law = 決まりをはっきり言い渡す

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: and let them know, because they need to know who their grandfather is.
lines.en_display: and let them know, because they need to know who their grandfather is.
lines.jp: 自分のじいちゃんが何者か 知っとかなきゃいけねえからな

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: Not celebrity and none of that other stuff,
lines.en_display: Not celebrity and none of that other stuff,
lines.jp: セレブとか そういうのじゃなくて
lines.note: and（large-v3）/ or（medium.en）。Critic の確認で and を採用

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: but who he is up close and personal, with being a part of their life.
lines.en_display: but who he is up close and personal, with being a part of their life.
lines.jp: 孫の人生にちゃんと関わってる 素のじいちゃんをな

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: My grandfather was my best friend my first 12 years on this earth.
lines.en_display: My grandfather was my best friend my first 12 years on this earth.
lines.jp: 俺のじいちゃんは 生まれてから12年間 俺の親友だった
lines.note: ここから自分の祖父の話

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: My mother could never whoop me.
lines.en_display: My mother could never whoop me.
lines.jp: おふくろは俺をシバけなかった
lines.note: whoop = 子供を叩いてしつける

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: She could never do none of that to me,
lines.en_display: She could never do none of that to me,
lines.jp: そういうことは 一切できなかった

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: but when he wasn't around, I got beat.
lines.en_display: but when he wasn't around, I got beat.
lines.jp: でも じいちゃんがいない時は シバかれた

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: But when he was ever around...
lines.en_display: But when he was ever around...
lines.jp: でも じいちゃんがいる時は…
lines.note: 言いかけて次のエピソードへ移る

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I got suspended from school and I knew I was gonna get beat.
lines.en_display: I got suspended from school and I knew I was gonna get beat.
lines.jp: 学校で停学くらって 絶対シバかれるって わかってた
lines.note: gonna / going to はモデル差。口語の gonna を採用

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: He lived right here, and my mama house was right here.
lines.en_display: He lived right here, and my mama house was right here.
lines.jp: じいちゃんちがここで おふくろの家がここ
lines.note: 手で位置を示しながら。mama house は所有の 's を落としたAAVEの形のまま

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I had to pass his house before I went home.
lines.en_display: I had to pass his house before I went home.
lines.jp: 家に帰る前に じいちゃんちを通るんだよ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I went there, sat down with him, watched Rasslin' and Bonanza.
lines.en_display: I went there, sat down with him, watched Rasslin' and Bonanza.
lines.jp: そこに寄って じいちゃんと座って プロレスとBonanzaを見てた
lines.note: Rasslin' = wrestling の南部・黒人口語の発音（medium.en 2回 / large-v3 1回）。Bonanza は60〜70年代の西部劇ドラマ（固有名詞なので英語のまま）

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: He said, "Why you here so early?"
lines.en_display: He said, "Why you here so early?"
lines.jp: じいちゃんが「なんでこんな早えんだ？」
lines.note: "He said," と "why" の間の呼びかけ（Sonny?）が聞き取れず。不確実なので字幕から外した → §D

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I said, "Papa, I got suspended.
lines.en_display: I said, "Papa, I got suspended.
lines.jp: 俺は「じいちゃん 停学くらった
lines.note: ここの Papa は祖父のこと。日本語の「パパ」だと父親と誤解されるので「じいちゃん」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: My mom gonna beat me."
lines.en_display: My mom gonna beat me."
lines.jp: ママにシバかれる」
lines.note: 子供の頃の自分のセリフなので「ママ」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "Your mom ain't gonna do shit to you.
lines.en_display: "Your mom ain't gonna do s**t to you.
lines.jp: 「母ちゃんなんか 何もできやしねえよ
lines.note: 祖父のセリフ（Snoopが声色を変えて再現）。large-v3 全体パスは shit を落としたが区間再確認で確定

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: I'm finna tell her right now."
lines.en_display: I'm finna tell her right now."
lines.jp: 今すぐ言ってやる」
lines.note: finna（large-v3, 0.97）/ gonna（medium.en）。どちらでも意味は同じ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "Don't tell her, Papa. Please."
lines.en_display: "Don't tell her, Papa. Please."
lines.jp: 「言わないで じいちゃん お願い」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "No, hell no. I'm telling her right now."
lines.en_display: "No, hell no. I'm telling her right now."
lines.jp: 「ダメだ 冗談じゃねえ 今すぐ言う」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "Beverly, Snoopy got suspended, and you ain't doing shit.
lines.en_display: "Beverly, Snoopy got suspended, and you ain't doing s**t.
lines.jp: 「Beverly Snoopyが停学になったが お前は何もすんじゃねえぞ
lines.note: 祖父から母への電話。Beverly はSnoopの母の名前、Snoopy は祖父が呼ぶ愛称。you ain't doing shit = 手出しするな

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: He's here with me watching Rasslin' and Bonanza."
lines.en_display: He's here with me watching Rasslin' and Bonanza."
lines.jp: 今 俺とプロレスとBonanza見てるからな」
lines.note: Rasslin' は024と同じ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "I'm beating his ass when he get out here!"
lines.en_display: "I'm beating his ass when he get out here!"
lines.jp: そしたらおふくろが「帰ってきたら ケツひっぱたいてやる！」
lines.note: 母のセリフ。"get out here" の out は低確率（3モデルとも同じ語順）。意味は「ここ（家）に来たら」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: On the back of the phone: "Please, mama, I ain't gonna do it, please!"
lines.en_display: On the back of the phone: "Please, mama, I ain't gonna do it, please!"
lines.jp: 後ろで俺が「ママ お願い もうしないから お願い！」
lines.note: on the back of the phone = 電話口の後ろで（子供のSnoopが叫んでいる）。medium.en 全体パスの "I hear her" は他のパスに無いため不採用

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: "She ain't gonna do shit.
lines.en_display: "She ain't gonna do s**t.
lines.jp: 「母ちゃんは何もしやしねえ
lines.note: 祖父がSnoopに

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: He's spending the night with me."
lines.en_display: He's spending the night with me."
lines.jp: こいつは今夜うちに泊まる」

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: And so my grandpa was a G, you know what I'm saying?
lines.en_display: And so my grandpa was a G, you know what I'm saying?
lines.jp: だから じいちゃんはマジでGだったんだよ わかるだろ？
lines.note: a G / G はモデル差。G = gangster から来た「筋が通った強い男・本物」という褒め言葉。日本のHIP-HOPリスナー向けに G のまま

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: Mom couldn't break that, you know what I'm saying?
lines.en_display: Mom couldn't break that, you know what I'm saying?
lines.jp: おふくろも そこは崩せなかった わかるだろ？
lines.note: break that = じいちゃんの守りを崩す

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: Like, that protector.
lines.en_display: Like, that protector.
lines.jp: 守ってくれる存在っつうかさ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: But despite mama being, you know, disciplinary,
lines.en_display: But despite mama being, you know, disciplinary,
lines.jp: でも おふくろは まあ 厳しかったけど

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: she was an amazing protector.
lines.en_display: she was an amazing protector.
lines.jp: 最高に俺らを守ってくれた

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: Because when you were a single mother raising men
lines.en_display: Because when you were a single mother raising men
lines.jp: シングルマザーで 男の子を育ててたんだぜ
lines.note: raising men = 息子たち（Snoopと兄弟）を育てる

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: in the '70s and the '80s,
lines.en_display: in the '70s and the '80s,
lines.jp: 70年代 80年代にさ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: and from what we was encountering and the things we was seeing when we was outside of our home,
lines.en_display: and from what we was encountering and the things we was seeing when we was outside of our home,
lines.jp: 俺らが家の外で 出くわしてたことや 見てたもんを考えたら
lines.note: 2つ目の we was / we were、outside of / at はモデル差。AAVEの we was を維持

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: she did an amazing job.
lines.en_display: she did an amazing job.
lines.jp: おふくろは 本当によくやってくれたよ

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: And I understand now, as a father and a grandfather,
lines.en_display: And I understand now, as a father and a grandfather,
lines.jp: 今 父親として じいちゃんとして わかるんだ
lines.note: large-v3 は "as a, as a" と言い直しを聞いている。言い直しは字幕にしない

lines.speaker: Snoop Dogg
lines.en: how hard it is to raise a kid, or kids, when it's you by yourself.
lines.en_display: how hard it is to raise a kid, or kids, when it's you by yourself.
lines.jp: 1人で子供を 子供たちを育てるのが どれだけ大変か

lines.speaker: Host (woman, on camera at the end)
lines.en: Do you feel like there's really a big difference between children that grow up with both their parents...
lines.en_display: Do you feel like there's really a big difference between children that grow up with both their parents...
lines.jp: 両親そろって育った子と… 本当に大きな違いってあると思う？
lines.note: 質問の途中で動画が終わる（比較の相手「片親の子」は言われていない）。日本語も「…」で途切れを示す
